verdict.rationale: Rootly's incident pages reference 'roles' as an incident attribute (rootly-docs-53) and offer automation/workflows that create channels, update stakeholders, and file tickets consistently (rootly-docs-34, rootly-docs-16/29/41), which supports coordinated response, but the evidence never explicitly documents defined role types like Incident Commander/Comms Lead or a task checklist feature for responders to track under pressure. Missing for 10: explicit incident commander/comms-lead role definitions and assignment workflow, and a dedicated task/checklist feature with completion tracking during an active incident.
